research_experience: Marie Sklodowska-Curie Postdoctoral Fellow at the University of Barcelona leading the YoungFitT project.
Postdoctoral and research-associate experience in exercise physiology, exercise neuroscience, stress-related outcomes, cognition and brain-health research.
PhD research on pre-pubertal exercise, hippocampal plasticity, neurotrophic factors and glucocorticoid regulation using animal models.
Human intervention research across university students, older adults, children, children with autism spectrum disorder and adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities.
Collaborative research involving MRI, cortisol, NR3C1 methylation, lifestyle factors, gut microbiota and mixed-methods intervention components.
International collaboration, scientific writing, protocol development, project coordination, mentoring, dissemination and conference activity.
teaching_and_supervision: University-level teaching in exercise physiology-related subjects, including Clinical Exercise Physiology, Pediatric Exercise Physiology and Laboratory Techniques in Exercise Physiology.
Supervision and co-supervision of MSc and undergraduate research projects.
Mentoring of postdoctoral and early-career researchers and supervision of an Erasmus+ trainee.
professional_experience: Exercise Physiologist at FIT Club Sports Medicine Clinic.
Coach for children's games and sports.
Head of Research Committee at the Iran Children's Play and Sports Association.
transferable_strengths: Exercise-intervention expertise transfers naturally into adjacent health, behavioral, brain, stress, rehabilitation and prevention research when responsibilities are aligned.
Stress-biology and psychophysiology experience can transfer into broader human stress, resilience, mental-health and behavioral-medicine research.
RCT design, project coordination and multidisciplinary collaboration can transfer into lifestyle, prevention and health-promotion research.
Teaching, supervision, mentoring and grant-writing experience supports early-faculty and research-leadership roles in addition to postdoctoral roles.
Animal neuroscience experience can support translational exercise-neuroscience roles when the vacancy values cross-model understanding rather than a single specialist technique.

adjacent_domains: translational neuroscience where exercise expertise is relevant
epigenetics related to stress and exercise
gut microbiota in lifestyle and health research
soft_preferences: Prefer research-intensive roles with substantive overlap in exercise, physical activity, brain health, stress, cognition, psychophysiology, human intervention research or closely adjacent health domains.
Interdisciplinary roles should remain in consideration when responsibilities fit transferable expertise even if the title or department name does not exactly match core domains.
Postdoctoral, research fellow, early faculty and research scientist roles are generally stronger targets than roles dominated by unrelated administration or teaching.

hard_constraints: Do not treat roles requiring a medical degree, nursing degree or mandatory professional healthcare registration as eligible unless the vacancy explicitly allows an alternative qualification supported by this profile.
Do not treat a specialist method as satisfied when the profile only has EXPOSURE or DO_NOT_CLAIM status for that method.
Do not infer citizenship, unrestricted work authorization or professional licensure from academic employment history.
Spanish may be treated as B1 evidence and English as fluent evidence; do not infer higher local-language proficiency without explicit evidence.
do_not_infer: advanced independent fMRI preprocessing or specialist neuroimaging analysis
advanced machine learning or AI research expertise
citizenship or unrestricted work authorization in any country
Spanish proficiency above B1 without new explicit evidence
other local-language proficiency without explicit evidence

evaluation_guidance.recall_priority: Recall is more important than precision. When a role is plausibly relevant but evidence is incomplete or interdisciplinary, prefer REVIEW over an unjustified SKIP.
evaluation_guidance.transferable_fit: Evaluate whether responsibilities and essential criteria can realistically be satisfied through transferable research, intervention, stress-biology, exercise-science, teaching, supervision, project or quantitative experience. Do not require exact keyword overlap.
evaluation_guidance.title_handling: Job title alone is not decisive. Infer the actual scientific role from the full vacancy text, responsibilities and criteria before judging fit.
evaluation_guidance.eligibility_handling: Distinguish mandatory requirements from preferred ones. A preferred criterion should not become a hard blocker. If a mandatory criterion is ambiguous, represent uncertainty rather than inventing eligibility.
evaluation_guidance.evidence_preference_separation: Treat evidence_profile as claims supported by the CV and search_preferences as targeting choices. Never convert a preference into evidence of qualification, and never suppress valid evidence merely because it is outside a preferred domain.
